query_llm_with_history: query an LLM model using a list of history items and return the model response
update_llm_stats: update token counts and cost statistics for the LLM model and check cost limits
convert_history_to_messages: convert a list of history items into formatted messages for LLM API calls
setup_litellm_client: initialize the LiteLLM model client with model metadata from litellm model cost database
check_context_window: validate that input tokens do not exceed the model maximum input token limit
